title: Zetta-Joule reactor stage
description: A pale-blue section: label and statement in navy, then a pinned stage with a boxed tag top-left, a right-aligned spec list top-right and a tall product model in the middle. While pinned the model rises into place and four notes (title, hairline, text) fade up around it one by one. On phones everything stacks: tag, specs, the four notes, then the model cropped at the bottom.
notes: the pinned stage is desktop only (lg+) and needs CSS scroll-driven animation; otherwise the stage is one static screen with everything visible
the original shows a three.js model here: pass a transparent render as media
